steps.en: Download the single binary; the same file runs local mode, server and client
steps.zh: 下载单个二进制，本地模式、服务端、客户端都是它

steps.en: Create a table with a MergeTree engine and a primary key matching your usual filters
steps.zh: 建表时指定 MergeTree 引擎，主键按最常用的过滤条件排

steps.en: Load data in large batches, e.g. straight from files in S3
steps.zh: 大批量写入，比如直接从 S3 上的文件导入
steps.code: INSERT INTO nyc_taxi SELECT * FROM s3(...)

steps.en: Writes each batch as an immutable, sorted, compressed part and merges parts in the background
steps.zh: 每批写成一个不可改、已排序、已压缩的数据块，后台再合并

steps.en: Ask aggregate questions in ordinary SQL
steps.zh: 用普通 SQL 提聚合类问题

steps.en: Reads only the columns the query names, skips blocks the primary key rules out, uses all cores
steps.zh: 只读查询用到的列，按主键跳过无关数据块，多核并行算

value.en: Interactive aggregates over large event tables without pre-computing rollups or running a warehouse service
value.zh: 大事件表上的聚合能交互式出结果，不用预先算汇总表，也不用买数仓服务

sources: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse README (How To Install: curl https://clickhouse.com/ | sh)

https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-docs docs/getting-started/quick-start/oss.mdx (single binary runs clickhouse-local / server / client; CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = MergeTree PRIMARY KEY; inserts create parts merged in the background; bulk inserts; INSERT INTO nyc_taxi SELECT * FROM s3(...))
